question: Which of the following is a festival and dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bihu**:-

 
 
• **It is a festival and dance that is celebrated in the state of Assam, India.**
 
• It is celebrated to mark the beginning of the Assamese New Year and the onset of the agricultural season.
 
• The festival is characterized by traditional Bihu dances and music, which involve the use of instruments such as dhol, pepa, and taal.
 
• Bihu is typically celebrated in mid-April and is a time of joy and festivity for the people of Assam. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Baisakhi:-**

 
 
• It** **is a festival celebrated in North India, particularly in Punjab, to mark the harvest season and the beginning of the Sikh New Year.
 
 
 
• **Ugadi:-**
 
 
• **​**It is a festival celebrated in South India, particularly in the states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Karnataka, to mark the New Year and the onset of spring.
 
 
 
• **Pongal:-**
 
 
• It​** **is a festival celebrated in Tamil Nadu to mark the harvest season and the beginning of the Tamil New Year.
